parameters.content:
## 08-17-02 automate volunteer shift signups and reminders

### How it works

1. A volunteer picks a shift and fills the signup form with their name, email, phone and experience.
2. The submission is validated, the shift is looked up in the Shifts sheet and the current signup count is checked.
3. When the shift still has space, an AI agent writes a warm confirmation email that is sent to the volunteer and the coordinator gets a Telegram alert.
4. When the shift is full, the volunteer goes on the waitlist, gets a friendly waitlist email, and the coordinator is alerted.
5. Every day at 6am volunteers with a shift today or tomorrow get a reminder email and the coordinator gets a Telegram recap.
6. Every Monday a weekly digest with signup stats, coverage and open shifts is written by AI and sent by email and Telegram.

### Setup steps

- Connect Google Sheets, OpenAI, Gmail and Telegram credentials.
- Create a spreadsheet with two tabs: Shifts and Signups.
- Add your open shifts with date, time, location and capacity to the Shifts tab.
- Share the form link at /form/volunteer/signup with your volunteers.
- Set the reminder and digest schedules to your preferred times.

### Customization

- Change the signup questions, the email tone, or the AI prompts to match your organization.

## Signup intake and validation

Volunteers sign up through the form. The submission is checked, the shift is looked up and the current signup count decides the next step.

parameters.content:
## AI confirmation and waitlist

When space is available an AI agent writes a warm confirmation email. When the shift is full the volunteer gets a waitlist email and the coordinator is alerted.

## Daily reminders

Every morning volunteers with a shift today or tomorrow get a reminder email and the coordinator gets a recap.

## Weekly digest

Every Monday an AI writes a summary of signups, hours and open shifts and sends it by email and Telegram.
